title: EN TEMPORAL-REFERENT ORGAN — WordNet noun-gloss whole-clause sweep
status: PROPOSED ORGAN — HER ADOPTION PENDING. The English twin of the committed zh organ (moe_temporal_referent_organ_54.py). A rule/derivation labeler, NEVER a scalar ruler. Concludes nothing; the field owner adopts / amends / severs / rejects.

law.name: whole-gloss clause law (EN)
law.statement: Temporal-referent charge is read from whole-gloss clause frames; the <=8-char lead-anchor was REJECTED (it failed 2/14). Duration/era/lifespan knowledge lives in trailing clauses. Routes scan the whole gloss; a frame counts only inside ONE clause (split on ';' and sentence '.'), so cross-clause concatenation cannot forge a hit.
law.seed_probe: the zh organ's en_probe() 12-word seed, confirmed 9/12 there; reproduced here as a fail=stop selftest

scope.note: ALL WordNet NOUN synsets and their lemmas (referents are nominal); the noun-only scan reproduces the 9/12 seed probe exactly

classes.seasonal_SEVERABLE: pole 'seasonal' — season-of-referent (zh 白露 analog) + plant-lifecycle
classes.tempo_SEVERABLE: severable instantaneity sub-route poled 'ephemeral' (mirrors zh EPH_TEMPO / the cut register tempo-592); thin & narrow by design
classes.metaphor_tagged: a FLAG on charged clauses carrying a figurative marker (zh 比喻 analog)

route_notes.clause_law: split on ';' and sentence '.'; a frame must sit in one clause
route_notes.plant_lifecycle_gate: annual/perennial/biennial fire only with a PLANT head-word in the same clause — kills 'annual award', 'perennial complaint/stream'
route_notes.former_era_gate: leading preposition (in/from/of/during) required, so 'at an earlier AGE' (life-stage) does NOT fire while 'in a former period' does
route_notes.tempo_narrowness: bare abrupt/sudden/rapid/swift/instantaneous/periodic REJECTED — see rejected_candidate_audit; lightning survives via 'for a second'
route_notes.overnight: inherited from the blessed seed probe (dew's charge); a one-night duration cue that doubles as a WHEN-word — declared, kept to reproduce the seed faithfully
judgment_calls: enduring:extinct — pastness-by-extinction (the referent no longer exists → past era). Declared, separable; the field owner can drop it.
seasonal is a SEVERABLE class (both sub-routes); mirrors the zh seasonal severability.
tempo is SEVERABLE and poled ephemeral; mirrors zh EPH_TEMPO and the cut tempo-592.
medieval / long-lasting / a-long-time added to enduring (clean, in-class, low-noise).
meteor / tortoise / redwood stay ∅ — honest: WordNet does not lexicalize their duration (redwood mirrors the zh 松 ruling exactly).

metaphor_finding.note: WordNet noun glosses do NOT co-mark figurative lifespan with an explicit marker (unlike zh 比喻…短暫). The EN analog carrier is the ABSTRACT-HEAD gloss ('something transitory' / 'anything short-lived') — 4 charged synsets. This is an honest cross-lingual ∅ for the explicit-marker metaphor class.
